bunkers.com: Good condition, no visible mat, when raked sand that is built up at bunker entry/exit needs to be raked/boarded back to base.

All kinds of mat visible on face and base in a spot that can disrupt play. Lomandra’s need to be pulled out, lip on non play side needs to be re-worked. Drainage rock spread throughout bunker and sand very dusty, hard to play out of.

No mat showing on base, some visible on face. Sand dusty but playable and looks good when groomed. Rock dragged down from face mixed in with base sand that is an issue. Lomandras need to be pulled out.

No mat on base, very playable and look nice when groomed. Some may visible on face. Base mixed in with rock that has been dragged down from the play side face. Rock needs to be removed to prevent this, sand also pretty dusty.
Mat visible on base and will disrupt play on play side of base. Sand can be dragged from non play side of base but sand is dusty and poor to play out of.
Excessive amounts of mat on base and face, will affect play. Some drainage rock mixed in with sand. Non play side edge is not very defined but that may be what we want.

No mat on base but mat visible on face. Tongue on non play side has lost its shape a little but looks a bit wild which isn’t too bad. Tongue on greenside is a bit of a strange shape and could use a re work. Bunker drains well.

Some mat visible on base, not in areas where the ball commonly goes. Bunker holds water. Good shape on greenside edge but could be better on surround edge. Decent sand when groomed but has been mixed in with rock from face.
Some mat visible on left side of base that could affect play. Lots of mat visible on face. Fairway edge needs to be touched up to be a hard edge as that would look really good. Tongue shape okay.

No mat visible on base, good playable bunker when groomed. Weeds build up very fast on face when left. Water holds bunker on far side of base. Play side edge falls away into bunker which could be sharpened up.
No mat visible on base, bunker holds water in 2 different spots. Holds a strong shape on the play side that looks really good, tongue on play side is a rectangle shape that looks quite strange.
A little bit of mat visible on base close to sand pro entry point. Bunker has a strong shape. Little step on tongue could be removed. Sand good to play out of when groomed.

Bunker in good condition, recently renovated with natural sand. Quickly fills up with leaves and sticks that need to be blown out when groomed. Small animal holes visible on top of face that need to be filled in when groomed.
Newly renovated bunker so in good condition, holds water though so drainage is an issue. Sand in good condition and plays well when groomed.
Base and face in good condition, sand is good for play when groomed. Edges are very thick and rugged which they should be in a bunker that deters golfers from the fence line.
Base and face has mat everywhere, tree roots showing through bunker edges and face. Non play side edge crumbling and tongue thinning. Always has leaves and sticks in it from tree overhanging.

Base has a thin sand layer, mat visible in collection point of bunker that will affect play. Mat also visible on face. Play side edge is very strong and looks good, non play side edge and tongue could use some work/sharpening up.
No mat visible on base but lots of mat visible on face. Sand is decent when it is decompacted and groomed. Play side edge is good. Tongue could use some minor works to sharpen it up.

No mat visible on base but mat is visible on face. Holds water in collection point. Shape is okay on play side but could be better on non play side. Builds up with weeds very fast. Tongue shape is not good and needs to be redone.

Some mat visible on base and face. Water builds up in collection areas. Play side shape is solid but non play side shape needs work. Sand pro entry point/beginning of bunker is built up with sand and edge is run down, looks quite poor.
Mat visible on base and face. Sand dry. Bunker needs new shape.
Natural sand so no mat visible. Edges could be sharpened up as they have eroded a bit but bunker plays and drains well. When groomed leaves and sticks need to be blown out.
Mat visible on face. Lots of rock on face that mixes in with bunker sand. Shape needs major attention. Bunker very dry.
Mat on base and face. Play side shape okay but non play side needs work. Sand very dry and mixed in with rock from face.
No mat visible. Same mixed in with rock from fade shape is okay but non play side needs work if it is to be a fairway edge. Holds water.
Shape needs work all round. No mat visible. Island needs work. Sand firm but playable for bunker this far out.
No mat visible. Shape is crumbling. Tongue on both sides need work. Firm sand but okay for fairway bunker this far from hole.
nothing good to say about this bunker. Mat everywhere, terrible shape. Needs complete renovation.
Mat visible on base and face. Bunker has no real shape.
Mat visible on face. Sand mixed in with rock. Shape needs work. If non play side is to be a play side with new fairway needs new shape. Bunker holds water.
Some mat visible on face. Sand mixed in with some rock and very dry. Shape is okay, where bike enters needs attention. Collection areas constantly have sand pulled out of.
Little bit of mat visible in collection area. Shape is okay play side, tongue shape needs work. Non play side shape needs work. Sand is pulled from collection area to bunker entry.
No mat visible on base or face. Shape of bunker could be strengthened on play side. Where bike enters has been flattened. Nice rough on non play side. Play side tongue in good shape.
No mat visible on base or face. Non play side tongue needs to be re shaped slightly but still retain wild look. Sand a bit dry but not a huge problem.

Mat visible on base and face. Bunker very shallow and sand is not good for play. Face where bike enters is too long and could be filled in. Bunker that should be punishing for golfers as it is close to boundary.
Mat visible on base and face. Bunker has a decent shape but needs to be strengthened on play side. Non play side edge and rough is good. Sand very dusty. Probably just needs top up and new edges.
Mat visible on base and face. Sand mixed in with drainage rock. Play side shape not too bad, non play side and tongue needs work. Drains well

play side shape could be sharpened. Non play side needs work. Where bike enters needs work. No mat. Far left side face and edge could be nicer. Sand is constantly displaced from collection area front right.
No mat. Sand very firm. Shape needs work. Right side long face of bunker is strange and could be removed. Holds water.
Bunker in good shape. Sand is good. Non play side shape could be better, where bunker bike enters needs attention.
Some mat on face and base. Bunker edge on play side and non play side needs work. Enough sand in bunker as is to suffice.
Bunker edge needs work but no mat in bunker and sand is good.
No mat visible. Edge very thick and needs work. Sand mixed in with drainage rock.
No mat visible, edge needs work. Lots of weeds build up quick. Sand very dense.
No mat visible. Shape not too bad but surrounded by very thick couch. One of the more useless bunkers in golf. Probably gets 1 shot played out of it a month.

Base has disruptive mat visible. Sand mixed in with rock that has fallen from face. Rock on face all throughout the bunker. Shape makes no sense and edges are crumbling. Ugly kikuyu grass on edges and tongues.
Wild shape but could be cleaned up on the play side. Rock on face falling into bunker sand and mixed in. Mat visible on face. Play side tongue could be removed.
Huge faces, mat visible on bunker base. Has lost its shape, the rough merges into the base of the bunker with no face on one side which looks poor. Ugly kikuyu around edges.

Lots of disruptive mat visible on base. Sand quite dry but okay for fairway bunker. Faces long on play side. Transition from groomed to non play side edge could be better. Non play side shape/lip could be smoother but still wild.
Mat visible on base and face. Sand mixed in with drainage rock. Shape needs work. Front right of bunker is way too tight.
Play side shape okay. Non play side shape needs work. Sand mixed in with rock from face.
Shape needs work. Sand isn’t too bad. Low spots need to be topped up constantly.
Recently renovated, no mat. Shape at front side is square. Sand is dry in far side.
Newly renovated. Sand constantly is moved out of low spot.
Mat visible on face. Rock mixed in with sand from face. Shape needs work. Dry sand.
Mat visible on base and face. Drainage rock mixed in with sand. Shape needs work all round. Play side tongue looks bad.
Shape needs work all over. Fairway mowers struggle to cut right to the edge. Mat on base and face. Drainage rock mixed in with sand. Sand very dry.
Mat visible on base and face. Shape all over the place. Low spots get low quickly after adding sand. Sand gets very dry might need a sprinkler hitting it from time to time.
Mat visible on base and face. Shape could use work all round. Sand constantly needs to be pushed into low spot. Sand is decent quality.
Mat visible on face and some on base. Decent quality sand. Tongue in poor shape and could be re done. Shape on far side play side is nice but rest could use work.
Shape could use work. Sand very firm and dense as the bunker holds water. Little mat visible on face.
Mat visible on face. Shape not too bad considering position.
mat visible on face and base. Aggy pipe visible. Non play side shape is wild which looks okay. Play side could use some work. Sand isn’t too bad but mixed in with drainage rock.

Mat visible on base and face. Drainage rock mixed in with sand. Shape needs work all round. Sand gets pulled towards entry/exit points constantly. Sand very thin. Ugly kikuyu on non play side. Drains well.
Shape is bad, tongue is nearly falling apart. Sand isn’t great. Huge potential as great bunker position. Hard edge on play side would be nice.
Play side edge could go right up into and blend with fairway shape more. Mat visible on face and a little on the base. Non play side shape and face needs work as it’s far too long.

Mat visible on base and face. Non play side very strong and looks good. Play side edge could be sharpened up and flush with the fairway. Sand dusty but okay for fairway bunker. Faces could be steeper all the way around.
No mat visible on base, little on face. Bunker sand mixed in with some rock. Far side of bunker holds water when wet. Play side shape and edge goof but non play side edge could use some work.
Little mat visible on face. Sand very firm for a while after it’s wet. Play side shape is sharp but non play side needs work. Where bunker bike enters needs work.

Play side shape is good. Non play side shape needs work. Low spot constantly needs more sand. Holds water. UPDATE Sep 2026: sump found, exposed, cleaned out and re-sanded (Aug–Sep 2026); still holds water in an extreme event but drains…
No mat visible. Shape could be more aggressive and punishing given the position. Sand is way too thin and doesn’t suit other bunkers on course at all.

Fills with water when wet, base very firm and does not play well do to silt. Lots of mat and rock on face that gets mixed in with bunker base. Faces quite long and awkward and have lost their shape over time.
Lots of mat showing on base that can affect play. Tree roots showing in face. Fairway edge is strong especially at far end looking at the hole, tongue on play side holds a strong shape.

Sand recently re done with Billy bunker base. Sand is very light and thin which makes it difficult to make it stick to steep play side face and looks poor. Also makes base very bumpy and inconsistent after play.

Bunker also newly reconstructed. Native sand used to matches rest of course and sand stays on face. Bunker depth inconsistent throughout base. Play side edge could be straighter or a consistent curve.
Mat visible on base and face. Both drainage rock and rock from base mixed in with bunker sand but not too heavily. Non play side very dense with fescue and has a nice wild shape.
High usage bunker. Mat visible on base, sand mixed in with drainage rock lightly. Shape of far side of bunker reasonable, green side edge starting to droop down so could use a touch up.
High usage bunker, mat visible on base and face. Play side edge is strong and faces are steep enough all around for golf balls to reach the base, but faces could be steeper on far side of the bunker.
Mat visible on base and face, bunker shape needs re shaping. Sans inconsistent and dusty.
Lots of mat visible on base and face. Rock everywhere. No real shape to it. Sand dusty.
Mat on base and face. Shape not great. Rock everywhere. Sand dusty.
Mat visible on base and face. Play side shape, except for front left, is nice looking. Non play side shape could be re done. Face has rock visible, some mixing into bunker sand.
Mat visible on face, base is okay but sand isn’t great. Drainage from green causing bit of timber to wash out in heavy rain. Shape could be re done. Rock mixed in with sand.
Mat visible on base and face. Shape isn’t too bad. Sand mixed with rock. Could be re done alongside bunker 86.
Recently renovated a few years ago. No mat visible. Sand is good but tends to be a bit soft. Low areas need sand consistency moved into. Shape is good.
Mat visible everywhere. Sand is firm. Low spots arise quickly. Shape needs work.
Mat visible on base and face. Shape needs work. Holds water
